limitations.note: The patch clocked the rotation register but left data combinational, so after each rising edge it exposed the newly rotated bit instead of registering the pre-edge q[5].
The passing test counted the reset value as the first sequence bit and expected the second bit at the first rising edge, so it accepted the phase error and would reject the correct registered output.
